_rules: SEC-DEP-06. Only high/critical advisories with no fix available. Each entry needs a reason, mitigation and an expiry ≤ 90 days. scripts/audit.mjs fails CI on anything unlisted or expired.

advisories.reason: No patched braces release exists (advisory published 2026-09-18; latest braces 3.0.3 from 2024-05-21). npm's suggested fix downgrades eslint-config-next to 14, which is wrong.
advisories.mitigation: Dev-only: used by the lint tool, not in the runtime bundle (`npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty). Exploitation needs attacker-controlled glob patterns; ours are fixed in the repo config.
